title: Constraint satisfaction template
statement: A constraint satisfaction template over a domain $D$ consists of a finite set of predicate names, an arity for each predicate, and a Boolean evaluation function for each predicate on ordered tuples of domain elements of that arity; the value true means the constraint is satisfied.
hypotheses_covered: Each predicate has a natural-number arity
Each predicate has a Boolean evaluation function on tuples of domain elements of that arity
